title: Replace __ASSERT_NO_MSG with __ASSERT in meshcore/adapter.c
description: meshcore/adapter.c lines 278,285 use __ASSERT_NO_MSG(). Replace with __ASSERT(cond, "reason"). E.g. __ASSERT_NO_MSG(adapter->pending_tail < ARRAY_SIZE(adapter->pending)) → __ASSERT(adapter->pending_tail < ARRAY_SIZE(adapter->pending), "pending_tail overflows pending array"). Verify: build compiles (host cmake or cross-compile).
